Wheat.water_needs: Moderate. Critical at crown root initiation and flowering.
Wheat.rain_warning: Heavy rain during the ripening stage causes lodging and grain damage.

Rice.water_needs: High. Requires standing water for the majority of its growth.
Rice.rain_warning: Highly resilient to rain, but extreme flooding can submerge young seedlings.

Cotton.water_needs: Low to moderate. Drought tolerant once established.
Cotton.rain_warning: Rain during the boll-opening stage is devastating and ruins fiber quality.
